title: Romanian Politics
description: Pick a persona, form a party, print fliers, win votes, and turn villages into election battlegrounds with posters, ballot boxes, debates, snacks, and music discs.
body:
Romanian Politics: Campaign Trail is a light-hearted Forge 1.21.11 satire mod that turns Minecraft villages into tiny election battlegrounds.

Pick a campaign persona, create or join a party, print fliers, hand them to players or villagers, collect votes, and fill the world with campaign props, posters, debate items, snacks, and custom music discs.

Features:
- Campaign persona system
- Party creation and voting commands
- Clickable chat menus
- Campaign Drafting Desk for custom fliers
- Villagers can accept fliers and place posters
- Custom blocks, items, textures, and models
- Two custom music discs
- Survival recipes and loot tables

This mod is made for parody and Minecraft gameplay. It does not make real-world political claims or endorse real parties.
